battle.name: 洺水之戰
battle.brief: 武德五年（622）二月，劉黑闥築壺口壩引洺水灌唐軍，秦王世民遣宇文士及率精騎數千乘水而下破壩，洪水反淹黑闥軍，其眾大潰，黑闥與數百騎奔突厥，唐軍追圍洺州。卡面羅馬投石機不見於本役紀錄，同類的中國發石車只在攻城一端可用，破壞主力是壩堰與騎兵。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 交戰一方是唐高祖李淵在隋末建立的唐朝中央朝廷，另一方是劉黑闥在河北重新聚起的武裝割據勢力。唐軍的調度仍沿用隋唐官制：秦王李世民以行軍元帥的名義率關中宿衛與秦王府精騎出征，河北道行軍總管李世勣、河東道行軍總管李孝恭分道進兵，幽州總管羅藝一部在北方策應，兵資糧餉由尚書省調度，沿河東、河北兩道輸送，作戰將領多出身舊隋行伍、瓦崗降將與關隴勁旅。劉黑闥一方則以河北鄉里武裝為骨幹，收納竇建德覆亡後散入山澤的舊部與隋末流民，據洺州稱漢東王、建元天造，以范願為左僕射、董康買為兵部尚書、高雅賢為右領軍，並以詔書符檄號召河北舊寨，數月之間連取河北諸州，隨後又向東突厥求援。兩相比較，唐朝握有正統名分、關中兵源與國家財賦，劉黑闥則有鄉里人情與舊部名籍，但缺乏穩定財賦，外援須厚賄，遠征持久對他不利。
countriesEn: The two sides were the newly founded Tang court of the founder Li Yuan on one hand and, on the other, the separatist force that Liu Heita re-raised in Hebei. The Tang field organisation still followed the late Sui and early Tang administrative pattern: the Prince of Qin, Li Shimin, took command as chief of the field army with the palace guards of the Guanzhong base and the elite cavalry of his own household command, while Li Shiji as commander of the Hebei Circuit and Li Xiaogong as commander of the Hedong Circuit advanced on separate lines, and the forces of Luo Yi, commander of Youzhou, supported them from the north. Money, weapons and grain were handled by the Department of State Affairs and moved along the Hedong and Hebei circuits, and most of the officers were former Sui soldiers, former Wagang rebels who had surrendered, or troops of the Guanzhong and Longxi military households. Liu Heita's side rested on the armed villagers of Hebei, absorbing the survivors of Dou Jiande's army who had scattered into the hills after Hulao together with the displaced people of the late Sui. He proclaimed himself King of Eastern Han with the era name Tianzao, made Mingzhou his capital, appointed Fan Yuan as left chancellor, Dong Kangmai as minister of war and Gao Yaoxian as commander of the right army, and issued proclamations and tallies to call the old strongholds of Hebei back into the fold; within months he had taken Hebei's prefectures one after another and then sought help from the Eastern Turks. The Tang held the orthodox mandate, the Guanzhong manpower and the state's revenue, while Liu Heita had local sympathy and a register of old followers but no stable fiscal base, had to buy foreign aid dearly, and could not afford a long war.
people: 關鍵人物集中在一場水壩攻防與其後的追擊上。秦王李世民是全役主導者：他判斷劉黑闥依城壘與壺口壩之險，選擇依洺水立營而不急攻，並在壩成之後遣宇文士及率精騎乘水而下破壩，讓反沖的水勢自行摧散黑闥軍陣，隨即乘勝追擊。宇文士及受命領騎，是破壩與追擊的執行者。河北道行軍總管李世勣奉命討黑闥，負責河北一線的兵資與截斷諸州響應；河東道行軍總管李孝恭督造堰壩，抵擋黑闥引水灌營之計。劉黑闥本人以漢東王之名統軍，築壺口壩、據洺州城，最終在潰敗中只帶數百騎奔突厥。幕僚方面，范願以左僕射總理軍政，董康買掌兵部，高雅賢領右軍，河北舊將多在黑闥幕府中復職；唐軍方面則有幽州總管羅藝、秦王府舊將與關中宿衛諸校尉，另有秦王府記室參軍房玄齡等參贊軍務，記錄軍情並往返傳遞詔令。
peopleEn: The decisive figures of this action cluster around the struggle over the dam and the pursuit that followed. The Prince of Qin, Li Shimin, was the master of the whole operation: reading Liu Heita as a commander who would rely on the fortress and on the Hukou weir, he chose to pitch the Tang camp along the Mingshui instead of attacking at once, and once the dam was finished he sent Yuwen Shiji with picked cavalry to ride down the flood and break the works, letting the returning water itself shatter Heita's formation before the Tang pressed the pursuit. Yuwen Shiji, charged with the cavalry, carried out the break and the chase. Li Shiji, commander of the Hebei Circuit, was ordered to destroy Heita and looked after supplies in Hebei and the severing of the prefectures that still answered to him, while Li Xiaogong, commander of the Hedong Circuit, supervised the raising of a counter-dam to check the plan of drowning the Tang camp. Liu Heita himself commanded as King of Eastern Han, built the Hukou dam, held the city of Mingzhou, and in the end fled toward the Turks with only a few hundred horsemen. On his side Fan Yuan directed civil and military administration as left chancellor, Dong Kangmai held the ministry of war, and Gao Yaoxian led the right army, with many Hebei officers of the old regime restored to their former posts. On the Tang side stood Luo Yi of Youzhou, the veteran commanders of the Qin prince's command and the palace guards of the capital, together with such staff officers as Fang Xuanling, who served as recorder of the Qin prince's establishment, keeping the record of operations and carrying imperial orders back and forth.
kits: 卡面上的投石機是羅馬的繩索牽引式石砲（onager）：靠人力拉緊粗繩，把石頭甩過槓桿拋出，射程數十步，能擊碎城牆、樓櫓與密集人陣，造價低而結構簡單，代價是體積龐大、需平整地面與大量牽引人手。中國當時對應的器械是發石車，即把石砲架在車上、藉車架與繩索蓄力的投射器，東漢末曹操攻鄴城、三國諸葛亮攻陳倉都用過，唐初長安、洛陽與各州城也常備。洺水之役的交鋒本身由水壩與騎兵決定，發石車並無直接記載；真正可能用到投射器械的是隨後圍攻洺州城的一段，與井欄、雲梯、巢車同列。此外唐軍陣中有蹶張弓與大弩的弩手、馬槊與長刀步兵，掩護用的障車與拒馬，兵甲以皮甲與竹木札甲為主，旗幟與鼓角用於號令，糧秣則自河東與洛陽方向沿官道漕運，軍中飼料靠隨營牛馬與就地徵發。
kitsEn: The card's onager is the Roman traction stone-thrower: the crew hauled a heavy rope taut so that the stone was flung over a pivoting beam, with a range of several dozen paces, enough to smash walls, siege towers and crowded ranks; it was cheap and simple to build, but bulky, and it needed level ground and a great many men to haul the engine. The Chinese equivalent of the period was the fashi che, a stone thrower mounted on a cart and powered by the frame and ropes of the vehicle; it was used by Cao Cao against Ye at the end of the Eastern Han and by Zhuge Liang against Chencang in the Three Kingdoms, and the Tang kept such engines in the arsenals of the capital and of the prefectural cities. In the fighting at Mingshui the outcome was settled by the dam and by cavalry, and no record mentions a stone thrower there; the only stage at which such engines could have been employed was the subsequent investment of Mingzhou, where they stood in the same order of service as the mantlet towers, the scaling ladders and the observation towers. The Tang army also carried the heavy crossbows worked by the bow-pullers, lancers and sword infantry, wheeled and abatis-style barriers for cover, armour of leather and of lacquered wood and bamboo, and banners, drums and horns for signalling; grain came by the official roads from Hedong and Luoyang, while fodder for the animals was supplied by the baggage train's own cattle and horses together with local requisition.
tactics: 本役的戰術核心是「以壩制壩、乘水破壩」。劉黑闥依洺州城與洺水之險，築壺口壩蓄水上游，試圖以水攻逼迫唐軍離營或淹沒其營壘，並以騎兵在壩側監視；唐軍不與之爭鋒，先築堰壅住來水，把營地安在能控水的一側，待壩勢已成、蓄水將放未放之際，遣精騎由水側乘流而下，直搗壩工，決壩之後反用洪水衝擊黑闥在壩下集結的步騎，趁其隊形散亂，步騎並進追擊，迫其北走。圍城階段則回到常規攻城辦法：壕塹環城、雲梯蟠附、井欄臨城、巢車俯瞰城頭，攻具與防具互相對耗，並分兵斷其糧道與河北諸州的連絡。行軍方面，兩道大軍分進合擊，一軍當前拒水壩，一軍抄河北側後，供給線則依河東方向維持；秋冬水勢漲落、上下游的堰築與掘口時機，是全役最關鍵的技術變數。
tacticsEn: The tactical heart of the action was to match dam with dam and to ride the water down onto the enemy. Liu Heita, relying on the city of Mingzhou and on the line of the Mingshui, built the Hukou dam to hold back the upper water and used the flood to force the Tang camp to move or to drown it, with cavalry posted to watch the side of the works. The Tang did not contest the open ground. They first raised a counter-dam to hold the incoming water, sat with the camp on the side from which the flow could be controlled, and waited until the dam was complete and the reservoir stood full but not yet released. Then the picked cavalry rode down the water side, struck straight at the earthwork, and once the dam was opened the returning flood was used against Heita's own infantry and cavalry drawn up below the works; while his formation came apart, Tang infantry and horse went forward together in pursuit and drove him north. The siege that followed returned to ordinary practice: a trench ringed the wall, scaling ladders were brought up under cover, mantlets and observation towers gave access to the ramparts, engines and defences wore each other down, and detachments were sent to cut the grain road and the links with the Hebei prefectures. On the strategic level the two circuits advanced in separate columns and closed together, one army facing the dam and the other working round the northern flank, while the supply line was held open towards Hedong. The rise and fall of the water, and the timing of the cutting and the raising of the banks upstream and downstream, were the decisive technical variables of the whole operation.
data: 可確定的時間與空間要素大致如下：戰役發生於唐高祖武德五年，即公元622年，洺水在今河北曲周、洺州一帶，壺口距洺州城僅數十里，屬短程決戰範圍。唐軍兵力的總數史籍未詳，僅記世民所遣破壩的精騎為數千，黑闥一軍則在號召河北舊部後迅速膨脹，眾數常稱十餘萬，實際可用兵力當在數萬之數，通說認為其核心為數萬精兵與各寨鄉兵之眾。壩工自興築至決壩約歷數旬，需役夫數千人，蓄水期內黑闥以數千精兵列於壩側與壩下。決堤後軍眾多陷泥濘，記載稱溺死者以數千計，黑闥僅與數百騎得脫奔突厥，此即「其眾大潰」的由來。圍洺州歷時數十日，其後追擊北抵幽州、黎陽一線。劉黑闥終於翌年武德六年在洺州被擒斬，河北兵亂至此方告收束。除上述概數外，傷亡與繳獲的精確數字諸史不一，本卡不作推補。
dataEn: The elements that can be fixed in time and space are roughly these. The action took place in the fifth year of Wude under the Tang founder, that is 622 AD, on the Mingshui near Mingzhou in what is now the Quzhou district of Hebei; Hukou lay only several dozen li from the city of Mingzhou, so the whole engagement belonged to the short-range kind. The total size of the Tang army is nowhere stated, and only the picked cavalry of several thousand men sent by Li Shimin to break the dam is recorded. Heita's force, recruited from the old strongholds of Hebei, swelled quickly; the figures commonly quoted for it run to over a hundred thousand, and the troops actually available must have numbered in the tens of thousands, the core being several thousands of picked soldiers together with the village levies of the various strongholds. Building the dam from the start of the works to the breaking of it took a number of tens of days and required some thousands of labourers, and during the period of impounding Heita posted several thousand of his best men by the flank and below the works. When the dam was opened the troops were caught in the mud, and the accounts put the number drowned in the thousands, while Heita himself escaped with a few hundred horsemen to the Turks; this is the substance of the phrase that his host was utterly routed. The investment of Mingzhou lasted a number of tens of days, and the pursuit afterwards carried north to the line of Youzhou and Liyang. Liu Heita was finally taken and beheaded at Mingzhou in the following year, 623, and the rising in Hebei was then at an end. Beyond these general figures the records differ on the exact losses and captures, and no attempt is made here to fill in the gaps.
cause: 洺水之戰的直接起因，是劉黑闥在隋末河北重起兵端。竇建德於虎牢關覆亡後，其河北義軍餘眾散入鄉里與山澤，瓦崗舊將劉黑闥於武德五年初重新聚合，在河北響應者眾，數月之間連克河北諸州，進而於相州稱漢東王、建元天造、定都洺州，把「重整竇建德舊業」當作旗號。唐朝則剛在關中立足，河北新附諸州編戶齊民尚未安頓，地方豪強與私兵仍有相當力量，黑闥再起直接威脅洛陽與河北道的安全，因此太宗不得不親自主持這場討平。深層原因則在隋末遺留：河北連年戰亂、戶口流散，州縣官吏徵斂無度，鄉里對新朝的括戶與租調之制深感不便，故黑闥的號召能迅速生效；河北糧產雖厚，唐軍自關中、河東遠征，供養線拉得極長，久戰對唐方同樣不利。劉黑闥向東突厥求援，也顯示中原分裂的殘餘仍有外力可乘之機。
causeEn: The immediate occasion of the battle at Mingshui was the rekindling of arms in Hebei at the end of the Sui. After Dou Jiande's state was destroyed at the pass of Hulao, the survivors of his Hebei forces scattered among the villages and into the hills, and Liu Heita, an old Wagang commander, gathered them together again at the beginning of the fifth year of Wude. His appeal was answered widely in Hebei; within months he had taken the prefectures one after another, then proclaimed himself King of Eastern Han with the era name Tianzao at Xiangzhou, made Mingzhou his capital, and took as his banner the restoration of Dou Jiande's old enterprise. The Tang, for their part, had only just established themselves in Guanzhong; the newly attached prefectures of Hebei had not yet been settled, local magnates and their private retainers still held real strength, and Heita's rising directly threatened Luoyang and the security of the Hebei circuit, so the throne had no choice but to direct the suppression in person. The deeper causes lay in what the late Sui had left behind: Hebei had seen years of war and of flight from the registers, the officials of the commanderies and prefectures exacted taxes without limit, and the countryside found the new system's enumeration of households and its levy of grain and cloth oppressive, which is why Heita's summons took hold so quickly. And although the harvests of Hebei were rich, a Tang army marching out from Guanzhong and Hedong stretched its supply line extremely thin, so a long war was no less dangerous for the Tang. Liu Heita's appeal to the Eastern Turks also showed that the residue of a divided China could still be exploited by outside powers.
impact: 洺水之役的結果，不只是消滅一支部隊，而是把河北重新收歸朝廷秩序。唐軍破壩淹潰黑闥主力後，河北諸州重歸州縣系統，隋末以來以宗族、鄉寨為基礎的割據武力被拆散，豪強私兵被收編為官軍或解散，唐朝得以在北方推行均田、括戶與租庸調的新制，並以河北道作為對付北方游牧政權的前沿與糧源。從全局看，此役連同此前對竇建德、王世充的戰役，基本清除了隋末群雄割據的殘局，為貞觀之治的長期穩定提供了前提。另一層影響在北方邊防：黑闥奔突厥使中原一度可能被兩面夾擊，若任其借兵再入河北，唐室的北線將被迫分兵；此役之後唐方及時追擊，並在黑闥再犯時徹底殲除，避免了這一局面。技術層面上，壩堰之水第一次大規模決定了攻守的勝負，說明當時攻城已不只靠兵力與器械，還能把水利工程當作戰術手段；同時也讓中原軍隊看見投射型攻城器械在缺乏歐洲那種牽引式石砲與大型器械作坊時的侷限，後來唐代的守城仍以檑木、飛石與地形為主。
impactEn: The result of the battle at Mingshui was not merely the destruction of one armed band; it was the return of Hebei to the order of the government. After the dam burst and Heita's main force was drowned, the prefectures of Hebei went back into the system of commanderies and counties; the separatist military power that had rested on clans and village strongholds since the end of the Sui was broken up, the private retainers of the magnates were either enrolled into the regular army or dispersed, and the Tang was able to extend the new institutions of equal-field land, the enumeration of households and the grain and cloth levies into the north, with the Hebei circuit serving as the forward position and the granary against the northern steppe powers. Taken in the wider view, this battle, together with the earlier campaigns against Dou Jiande and Wang Shichong, cleared away essentially all of the residue of the late-Sui fragmentation and gave the long stability of the Zhenguan age its premise. A second effect lay on the northern frontier: Heita's flight to the Turks left the Central Plain in danger of being attacked from two sides, and had he been allowed to return with borrowed troops the Tang would have been forced to split its northern line; the timely pursuit after this battle, and the elimination of Heita when he came back, prevented that. On the technical level the water of the dam decided the issue of attack and defence on a large scale for the first time, showing that the siege of a walled place then rested not only on numbers and on engines but could treat hydraulic works as a tactical instrument; at the same time it exposed to the armies of the Central Plain the limits of the traction stone-thrower in the absence of the European type of engine and the workshops able to build it, and the Tang defence of walled cities continued to depend on beams, flying stones and on the ground itself.
result: 洺水一役，唐軍以壩壞水潰之計大破劉黑闥：壺口壩被決，蓄水反灌黑闥自己的軍陣，其眾大潰，劉黑闥僅與數百騎奔入突厥求援，唐軍乘勝追擊並重圍洺州，河北響應諸州多復歸朝廷，劉黑闥經營河北的根基就此崩解。然而這一役並非戰爭的終點：黑闥借突厥兵於同年冬再犯河北，斬唐將李道玄於下博；翌年太子李建成與齊王李元吉分道進軍昌樂一線，終於破敵，黑闥敗走館陶，被擒後斬於洺州。換言之，洺水之戰是唐平定河北的關鍵決戰：它拆掉了劉黑闥的兵員與號召力，使第二次平叛得以在一年內收尾；此後河北再未出現足以與唐抗衡的割據武裝，隋末亂局至此告一段落，而唐室在河北的統治也從「軍事鎮壓」轉向「制度安撫」，這份轉變的開端，正是在洺水河畔這場以水壩取勝的戰役之後。
resultEn: In the action at Mingshui the Tang broke Liu Heita with a plan that turned the dam against him: the Hukou works were opened, the impounded water was let down into Heita's own formations, his host was utterly routed, and Liu Heita escaped with a few hundred horsemen to seek help from the Turks. The Tang pressed the pursuit, closed around Mingzhou, and the Hebei prefectures that had answered to Heita returned to the court, so that the base he had built in Hebei came apart. Yet the battle was not the end of the war. With Turk troops he invaded Hebei again in the winter of the same year and killed the Tang general Li Daoxuan at Xiabo; in the following year the Crown Prince Li Jiancheng and the Prince of Qi Li Yuanji advanced by separate routes to the line of Changle and finally broke him, and Heita fled to Guantao, was taken and beheaded at Mingzhou. In other words, the battle at Mingshui was the decisive engagement in the Tang pacification of Hebei: it stripped Liu Heita of his troops and of his appeal, and let the second rising be settled within a year. After it, no separatist force in Hebei arose that could contend with the Tang, the disorder of the late Sui came to its close, and the Tang's rule in Hebei turned from military suppression towards institutional conciliation; the beginning of that turn lies precisely in this victory won at Mingshui by means of a dam.
